text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp said Friday it has completed an approximate $117.5 million asset securitization through the sale of automobile receivables-based notes and certificates.
Of the securities, $82.3 million of Class A-1 notes have a floating rate, and $30.6 million of Class A-2 notes have a fixed rate of 6.8 percent.
In addition, $4.7 million of asset-backed certificates were issued with a fixed rate of seven percent.
Proceeds from the offering were used to pay down its senior bank line, the company said.
The notes and certificates were issued by First Merchants Auto Trust 1996-B, which was formed specifically for the securitization.
First Merchants provides financing for the purchase of used automobiles for consumers who have limited access to traditional sources of credit.
